scenes.text: Hi, I'm Ryan Rover. What really changes when you have twenty thousand dollars in the bank? More than you think.
scenes.caption: RYAN

scenes.text: Twenty thousand dollars is the point where money stops being a daily worry.

card.label: in the bank
card.sub: the number that changes how you think

scenes.text: And it starts with something simple: cash you don't touch.
scenes.query: United States one hundred dollar bill
scenes.caption: CASH YOU DON'T TOUCH

scenes.text: One hundred dollars a month, invested for twenty years at seven percent, grows to about fifty two thousand dollars.
That's the power of time. Stay with me, and I'll show you the whole plan.
